rake: A sturdy tool to clear weeds from roadside patches before you plant.
seed_dibber: A sharp implement to push seeds deep into the soil for best growth.
spade: A heavy blade to dig up mature crops once they are ready to harvest.
watering_can: A tin vessel to pour water on crops for a slightly bigger harvest.
potato_seed: A small tuber to plant in level 1 patches for a quick, starchy reward.
onion_seed: A bulbous seed for level 5 patches that yields a pungent, useful vegetable.
cabbage_seed: A green packet for level 9 patches that grows into a hearty head for stews.
barley_seed: A golden grain for level 14 patches used to brew ale or make bread.
strawberry_seed: A red packet for level 19 patches that produces sweet, juicy fruit.
pumpkin_seed: A large orange seed for level 27 patches that grows into a heavy, round gourd.
moonleaf_seed: A silver packet for level 33 patches used by wizards to make spell ink.
frostbloom_seed: An icy blue seed for level 45 patches that only grows in the high snows.
potato: A freshly dug tuber ready to be baked or mashed into a filling meal.
baked_potato: A hot, fluffy potato roasted in the oven with butter and salt.
onion: A sliced bulb perfect for adding sharp flavor to soups and stews.
cabbage: A crisp green leaf wrapped tight, ideal for cooking down into a stew.
barley: A harvested grain that can be ground into flour or brewed into ale.
strawberry: A sweet, red berry that tastes best when eaten fresh from the patch.
pumpkin: A large orange gourd that can be carved into lanterns or made into soup.
moonleaf: A shimmering silver herb dried for use in creating powerful wizard spells.
frostbloom: A rare ice-blue flower that glows in the cold and is hard to find.

talk: Right, lad, time to get your hands dirty. Grab a rake, seed dibber, and spade from any general store.
Head to the roadside patch near the castle and clear the weeds before planting three potato seeds.
Water them, wait for the blocks to tick over, then dig up three potatoes to show me you can do it.
first_furrows.progress: You need to clear weeds, plant, water, and dig up three potatoes to start your journey.
first_furrows.complete: Three potatoes harvested! You've got the hang of the basics, Tobin is pleased.
first_furrows.done: Your first harvest is a success; the farm is finally taking shape.

talk: Orla needs greens for her famous mountain stew, and she wants them fresh from the patch.
You'll need to grow four cabbages in a level 9 patch, making sure to water them for the best yield.
Once they're fully grown, use your spade to dig them up and bring them straight to the lodge.
lodge_greens.progress: Grow four cabbages in a level 9 patch and dig them up for Orla's stew.
lodge_greens.complete: Four crisp cabbages delivered! Orla says the stew is better than ever.
lodge_greens.done: The lodge is happy with your greens; the mountain stew is a hit.

talk: The Circle of the Long Night needs fresh ink, and only moonleaf works for our ancient spells.
Find one of the rare large patches, plant two moonleaf seeds, and wait patiently for the silver glow.
When the blocks finish, dig up the moonleaf and bring it to me immediately for the Circle.
moonleaf_for_the_circle.progress: Plant and grow two moonleaf in a rare large patch for the Circle's spell ink.
moonleaf_for_the_circle.complete: Two moonleaf harvested! The wizards are thrilled to have fresh ink for their scrolls.
moonleaf_for_the_circle.done: The Circle is grateful; your magic is now ready to be written down.
